$comment: Files beginning with _ are ignored by the dashboard. This is the shape of every reservations/<TASK-ID>.json file.
title: os-lab task reservation

id.description: The roadmap task id being reserved, exactly as shown on the Contribute page (e.g. PENT-02, OS-11, FW-16, SRC-B01, CLN-04). The file name must be <id>.json.

name.description: Who is doing it — display name, and for students a number (e.g. 'Ada Mert K. · 2520191019'). Optional for external contributors.

course.description: Course code if this is a midterm reservation, else omit.

note.description: Free text. Midterm students: put your exam option number here (e.g. 'MYO062 vize seçenek 17') when several options map to one task id.

status.description: reserved = claimed, not started · in-progress = working · pr-open = PR opened (fill pr) · done = merged · released = giving it back.

pr.description: Your os-lab PR URL once opened.
